# Will your Kubernetes rollout drop live requests?

> Paste a Kubernetes Deployment YAML and find every reason a rolling update can drop live requests: no readinessProbe, no preStop hook, a grace period shorter than the drain, maxUnavailable covering every replica, a PodDisruptionBudget that blocks a node drain. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
